name: Windfury Ridge
summary: Windfury Ridge is a rugged highland area flanking the pastures of Mulgore. Notorious for harboring vicious harpies alongside predatory wolves and cougars, it poses a constant hazard to travelers while offering prized feathers to tauren artisans.

sections.title: A Perilous Perch
sections.body: Windfury Ridge rises sharply above Mulgore's serene plains, serving as the hunting grounds of the Windfury harpies. These vicious winged creatures nest high along the crags, readily swooping down upon any unwary wanderers who skirt the hills. The rocky terrain is further populated by prowling prairie wolves and wild mountain cougars, making the ridge one of the more treacherous borders of the tauren heartland. Despite the danger, the harpies are frequently hunted by brave tauren warriors; their vibrant, iridescent plumage is highly sought after across Thunder Bluff to adorn ceremonial garments for lavish feasts and wedding celebrations.

faq.answer: The ridge is teeming with predatory cougars and prairie wolves, but its most persistent menace is the flock of aggressive harpies nesting along the heights. They actively dive from the crags to capture or butcher intruders who wander too close to their nesting sites.

faq.q: Why do the tauren hunt the harpies on Windfury Ridge?
faq.answer: Beyond securing the borders from their predations, tauren hunt the Windfury harpies for their brilliant feathers. These colorful plumes are traditionally harvested and woven into ceremonial headdresses and decorations used during feasts and weddings.
Windfury Ridge lies along the elevated bluffs in the pastoral region of Mulgore, in the far north of Mulgore, beyond Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: The ridge is both a recurring nuisance to young hunters and a source of vital ceremonial ornaments used to honor marriages and seasonal gatherings.
The steep inclines and cunning predators provide an excellent early testing ground for tracking, beast taming, and range management.
